# `<sl-stat>` — Stat

> **Only in Saipem DS.** This component does not exist in upstream Shoelace or Web Awesome: use only the API below.

Stats show a count with a label as an icon-first KPI card, e.g. how many documents are in each status. Inside a [stat group](stat-group.md) they also act as filters.

**Status:** experimental · **Since:** 2.20

**Import:** `import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/stat/stat.js';`

## Attributes

Every attribute is also a property (camelCase name in the second column when it differs). Boolean attributes are on when present: never write `="false"`, remove the attribute or bind the property instead.

| Attribute | Property | Type / allowed values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | — | `string` | `''` | The value the stat group reports when this stat is selected. |
| `count` | — | `number` | `0` | The number to show. It's formatted for the current locale. |
| `variant` | — | `primary`, `accent`, `success`, `neutral`, `warning`, `danger`, `''` | `''` | Adds a coloured dot before the label, matching `<sl-status>`. Use the same variant as the status the stat counts, so "Distributed" is green both here and in the table. |
| `selected` | — | `boolean` | `false` | Draws the stat in a selected state. The stat group keeps this in sync with its value. |
| `disabled` | — | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the stat inside a stat group. |

## Properties without an attribute

These can only be set from JavaScript: `element.prop = value`, `[prop]="value"` in Angular, `.prop=${value}` in Lit. Writing them as HTML attributes does nothing.

| Property | Type | Notes | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `interactive` | `boolean` |  | Whether the stat sits in a stat group and can be selected. The stat group keeps this in sync. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| (default) | The stat's label. |
| `prefix` | An icon shown in the tinted badge, e.g. `<sl-icon>`. |

## CSS parts

Parts exist for fine adjustments. Do not use them to change colours, borders or fonts: a missing look is a missing variant of the DS.

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `base` | The component's base wrapper. A `<button>` inside a stat group, otherwise a `<div>`. |
| `icon` | The tinted circular badge that hosts the prefix icon. |
| `content` | The container that wraps the count and the label. |
| `count` | The formatted count. |
| `label` | The label. |

## Documentation and examples

Stats render as icon-first KPI cards: an icon in a tinted badge, a large count, and a label below it. The count is
formatted for the page's locale. Set `variant` to tint the icon badge with the same palette as [status](status.md),
so a stat and the table cells it counts share one colour.

```html
<sl-stat count="1284" variant="success">
  <sl-icon slot="prefix" name="check-circle"></sl-icon>
  Distributed
</sl-stat>
```

```ts
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/icon/icon.js';
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/stat/stat.js';
import { Component, CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA } from '@angular/core';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-stat-example',
  schemas: [CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA],
  template: `
    <sl-stat count="1284" variant="success">
      <sl-icon slot="prefix" name="check-circle"></sl-icon>
      Distributed
    </sl-stat>
  `
})
export class StatExampleComponent {}
```

## Examples

### As filters

Put stats in a [stat group](stat-group.md) to turn them into quick filters.

```html
<sl-stat-group label="Filter by status" value="working">
  <sl-stat value="working" count="8" variant="neutral">
    <sl-icon slot="prefix" name="clock"></sl-icon>
    Working
  </sl-stat>
  <sl-stat value="signed" count="1" variant="primary">
    <sl-icon slot="prefix" name="pencil"></sl-icon>
    Signed
  </sl-stat>
  <sl-stat value="distributed" count="8" variant="success">
    <sl-icon slot="prefix" name="check-circle"></sl-icon>
    Distributed
  </sl-stat>
</sl-stat-group>
```

### KPI summary row

A dashboard summary, e.g. contract review/consolidation status, with one stat selected. Variants map to tones:
`success` for Safe, `warning` for Expiring, `danger` for Expired, and `accent` for Notified.

```html
<sl-stat-group label="Filter by status" value="expiring">
  <sl-stat value="safe" count="128" variant="success">
    <sl-icon slot="prefix" name="shield-check"></sl-icon>
    Safe
  </sl-stat>
  <sl-stat value="expiring" count="14" variant="warning">
    <sl-icon slot="prefix" name="hourglass-split"></sl-icon>
    Expiring
  </sl-stat>
  <sl-stat value="expired" count="3" variant="danger">
    <sl-icon slot="prefix" name="exclamation-triangle"></sl-icon>
    Expired
  </sl-stat>
  <sl-stat value="notified" count="9" variant="accent">
    <sl-icon slot="prefix" name="bell"></sl-icon>
    Notified
  </sl-stat>
</sl-stat-group>
```

### Without an icon

The `prefix` slot is optional — the icon badge collapses when it's empty.

```html
<sl-stat count="3">Checked out</sl-stat>
```
